50" x 60", ideal size to snuggle up in

description: Snuggle up with the Sunbeam Royal Mink Sherpa Heated Throw to beat those winter chills. Indulge yourself with its luxurious and ultra comfy material with reverse side sherpa to keep you toasty all night long or warm as you unwind. Easy to use detachable controller with 4 heat settings and a 4-hour auto-shut off feature for peace of mind. Remove the controller and place the blanket into the washer and dryer for easy cleaning.
